messages:
jose: Heads-up — seen a flaky failure in the sample-app onboarding flow: schema validator on the function endpoint complaining about types after a retry. Repro is `jsonMode: true` + `retry` enabled in the SDK.

jose: Short repro: call with function_call that has `args` as an object. First request OK, retry arrives with `args` as a JSON string. Server schema -> error.

jose: Example SDK call:
```js
client.generate({
  model: 'redwood-oss-1',
  jsonMode: true,
  function_call: { name: 'submit_feedback', args: { rating: 5, notes: 'all good' } },
  retry: { retries: 1 }
})
```

tara: ugh. can you paste the raw payload from the http logger when the retry fires? might be the retry code re-serializing and wrapping inner objects.

jose: pasted trimmed log ->
OUTGOING -> { method: 'POST', path: '/v1/generate', body: '{"model":"redwood-oss-1","function_call":"{\"name\":\"submit_feedback\",\"args\":\"{\\\"rating\\\":5,\\\"notes\\\":\\\"all good\\\"}\"}"}' }

kevin: that's double-encoded for sure. The helper that builds the fetch payload does `body = JSON.stringify(req)` and then the retry wrapper does `JSON.stringify(body)` again when replaying. We had a similar footgun in auth token refresh code.

ci-bot: test-suite: failing -> `sdk/retry.spec.ts` should include case: preserves nested object types for `function_call.args` across retries. Failure: actual string.

mike: quick fix: make the retry wrapper clone the request object before stringify instead of starting from the serialized string. Specifically: `const replayReq = typeof originalReq === 'string' ? JSON.parse(originalReq) : deepClone(originalReq)` then `fetch(..., { body: JSON.stringify(replayReq) })`. Add guard that `function_call.args` is object.

tara: + add unit test that injects a mock fetch which returns 500 once so retry runs and assert that server receives a non-string `args`. Also add an e2e sample-app test so CI can catch regressions.

jose: I'll open a PR with the clone + tests + changelog note. Also updating sample-app quickstart to recommend disabling client-side retry until the patched SDK is released.

kevin: consider also logging a warning if `jsonMode` is true and `retry` > 0 in the SDK so users see a visible hint in dev mode.

mike: agreed, but make it behind DEBUG flag or only in dev to avoid noisy production logs.

tara: pairing offer — I can help write the test. tagging for devex triage. :shipit:
